levels.1: A first clear unlocks replay tools and artifact modifiers.

levels.1: The harder preset is the campaign's completion benchmark.

levels.2: Open every red-orb chest encountered in this physical region.

areas.name: Upgrades, Meters, and Artifact Modifiers

areas.note: Maximize all elemental and utility paths, both meters, and every artifact modifier.

levels.1: Keep one elemental branch funded until all of its move nodes are open.
levels.2: Purchase every upgrade attached to Fire of Ares.
levels.3: Equip Fire of Ares, spend red orbs on each available tier, and check the move list after the final purchase. Test its highest-level attack while the rage meter is active.

levels.2: Purchase every upgrade attached to Ice of Poseidon.
levels.3: Equip Ice of Poseidon, spend red orbs on each available tier, and check the move list after the final purchase. Test its highest-level attack while the rage meter is active.

levels.1: The utility tools also have upgrade entries in the power menu.
levels.2: Buy every available upgrade for Amulet of Uroborus.
levels.3: Open the upgrade menu after acquiring Amulet of Uroborus, purchase all listed tiers, and use the fully upgraded tool on a compatible traversal or combat target.

levels.1: Continue opening eye chests until the green bar stops growing.
levels.2: Collect twenty Gorgon Eyes to reach the health cap.
levels.3: Verify each completed set extends the health bar and the twentieth eye reaches the maximum. Open all eight later eye chests as red-orb conversions.

levels.1: The blue meter reaches its cap before every feather chest is exhausted.
levels.2: Collect fifteen Phoenix Feathers to maximize magic.
levels.3: Confirm the fifteenth feather produces the final magic increase, then open the remaining nine feather chests for their converted red-orb rewards.

levels.1: Artifacts become mechanical modifiers only after a campaign clear.
levels.2: Collect all ten artifacts and enable each unlocked cheat once.
levels.3: Load completed data, toggle one artifact modifier at a time, and perform a short combat or traversal test. Disable it before testing the next so every effect is verified independently.

areas.name: Multiplayer Progression
areas.location_cue: The online warrior menu, allegiance selector, match playlists, labor pages, and equipment tabs.
areas.note: Online as observed in 2026, but low population can require scheduled partners.

levels.1: The servers remain observable, but matchmaking population is limited.
levels.2: Connect to the multiplayer service and reach the warrior setup menu.
levels.3: Install the current patch, sign into PSN on compatible hardware, and open multiplayer. Confirm profile data loads; arrange partners for population-dependent modes rather than assuming public matchmaking will fill.

levels.1: The online warrior begins with a short allegiance tutorial.
levels.2: Finish the introductory online sequence and create the persistent warrior.
levels.3: Complete the prison tutorial, select an initial allegiance, finish the guided encounter, and verify the warrior profile and first loadout save to the server.

levels.1: Use a scheduled group if the public queue does not populate.
levels.2: Complete one full Team Favor session.
levels.3: Win or finish a team Favor match while using altars, traps, chests, and combat scoring.

levels.1: Use a scheduled group if the public queue does not populate.

levels.1: Free map updates expanded the launch rotation.

items.label: Unlock Every Shared and World Weapon

levels.1: Several weapons sit outside the four allegiance trees.
levels.2: Complete every shared-weapon shard or ownership requirement.
levels.3: Review the shared weapon screen, collect all white-chest parts and mode rewards, purchase every completed weapon, and level each to its maximum unlock tier.

levels.1: Stay aligned long enough to finish the entire normal progression tree.
levels.2: Earn multiplayer experience until the Ares allegiance reaches level 40.
levels.3: Select Ares, complete matches and labors until level 40, and verify every normal rank-gated entry in that allegiance has become available.

levels.1: The allegiance has a dedicated weapon menu beyond the starting option.
levels.2: Acquire and fully level every standard weapon under Ares.
levels.3: Open the Ares weapon list, satisfy every rank, shard, currency, and labor condition, then upgrade each owned weapon until no level node remains.

levels.1: Rank and labor rewards populate several three-piece armor sets.
levels.2: Acquire every head, chest, and lower-body armor piece under Ares.
levels.3: Review every Ares armor set, complete its rank or labor gate, and purchase all three pieces. Equip each completed set once to verify ownership.

levels.1: Magic, relics, and consumable items unlock separately from equipment.
levels.2: Unlock and maximize every magic, relic, and item assigned to Ares.
levels.3: Inspect all three Ares ability tabs, meet every rank and labor condition, buy each entry, and upgrade it to its final tier. Test one loadout containing all three categories.

levels.1: Several armor rewards require cumulative allegiance-specific actions.
levels.2: Finish every numbered labor chain associated with Ares.
levels.3: Track the Ares labor page after each match, repeat the required kills, assists, captures, executions, or ability actions, and continue until every tier shows complete.

levels.1: Godly equipment requires repeated level resets, not one prestige.
levels.2: Reach level 40 and perform six Ascension resets under Ares.
levels.3: At level 40, ascend to receive four tokens and return to level 1. Repeat the full climb six times, then spend the accumulated tokens on all six Godly weapons and all nine pieces across the three Godly armor sets.
